about.title: About Legendary Collection 4: Joey's World Mega Pack
paragraphs: Legendary Collection 4: Joey's World Mega Pack is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG tin released on 11 October 2013, in the ZEXAL era. It has 298 cards.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
